Momentum now

From our foundation to the future, Monash has always been about progress. By constantly evolving, we turn bold ideas into lasting change.

Your future starts today

Get involved

Join one of our student-run clubs and societies to make new friends, stay active and jump straight into uni life.

Our Academics

Our academics are at the heart of everything we do. Join our talented and ambitious academics to explore the unknown and make a difference in the world.

What does your future look like?

With education, we see a powerful future for you. Study with us and prepare to change the world.

Research with impact

Take the leap

A bubble keeps you safe, but it's limiting. Step beyond it, and that’s where real life begins!
